mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates strong economic growth, which positively impacts corporate earnings and drives up S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 8% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises above 8% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is strong but unemployment (UNRATE) is rising, it indicates potential labor market contradictions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Both PAYEMS growth and UNRATE rise, but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, higher federal funds rates increase borrowing costs, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises during tightening but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL) erodes purchasing power and corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL is high but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 indicates supply chain issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 95 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is high and retail sales (RSAFS) are low, it indicates economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS is high and RSAFS is low but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a slowdown in housing starts (HOUST) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: HOUST slows but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
